sum: RenX Enterprises Corp. engages in the biomass recycling, logistics, and real estate businesses. The company is involved in engineered soils, mulch production, and materials processing, such as compost, spoil, and muclh. It serves municipal entities, construction contractors, and landscaping companies. The company was formerly known as Safe and Green Development Corporation and changed its name to RenX Enterprises Corp.in December 2025. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Miami, Florida.
ceo: Mr. David  Villarreal Jr. (President, CEO & Director)
